provenance.note: One alfalfa stand for the whole run: a planting on the first day sets its state, and the 39 cuttings each remove 0.85 of the shoots and leave the stubble and roots alive. Cutting dates are read from the tower NDVI (Wang 2024 Fig. 3.1) and daily NEE (Hemes et al. 2019 Fig. S2), except the recorded 2020-06-04 mowing. No tillage and no fertilization: the stand is not tilled and the site record gives no fertilizer. Winter sheep grazing (delta-grazing-0002) is left out: the record has no dates or stocking and SIPNET has no grazing event. Irrigation is the monitoring product's. See tools/event_prep/README.md.

events.prior_filled: leaf_c_kg_m2<-median of the parcel's monitoring P1 plantings (6, planting v1.0)
events.source: Paw U et al. 2018, Field Campaign Report, Appendix B, p. B-SI-8; monitoring_product:planting/v1.0
events.provenance_note: Sets the state of the alfalfa stand at the start of the run; it is not a planting operation. The field had been in alfalfa about three years when the tower went in on 2016-08-12 (Paw U et al. 2018, Field Campaign Report, Appendix B, p. B-SI-8), so the stand dates from about 2013 and is kept for the whole run: the monitoring product's yearly P1 plantings are not used. The roots start at seedling scale, so 2017 behaves as spin-up. The date is assumed; leaf C is the median (David's rule) of the parcel's monitoring P1 plantings (6, 2018-2023), the weaker part, so the event is imputed.

events.harvest_fraction_note: Alfalfa cutting: the shared harvest lookup's P1 share (0.85) removed, the stubble and roots left alive (David on calibration#10).
events.source: Wang 2024, UC Berkeley PhD dissertation, Fig. 3.1 (US-Bi1 tower NDVI)
events.provenance_note: No record dates this cutting; dated from the fall in the tower NDVI cycle in Wang 2024 Fig. 3.1, to within about 3 to 5 days, so the event is imputed. The site record gives about six cuttings a year (delta-harvest-0010). Wang 2024 Fig. 3.1 (dissertation p. 52), 2022 panel: NDVI falls from about 0.63 (last high value, 2022-07-05) to 0.42 (2022-07-11); the cutting is dated within that fall. Digitized from the figure image in the organization#298 research (2026-11-03); the fall checked by eye against the figure on 2026-11-08, the date not re-digitized. The last cutting of 2022: after it the 2022 panel never regrows to the 0.6-0.7 canopy that precedes every other cutting. NDVI stays at about 0.30-0.45 through September (the record has a gap in early to mid August), rises slowly to about 0.50 by mid October, and falls to about 0.35-0.40 in late October and again in late December; neither fall is from a regrown canopy, so no cutting is written (the late October fall could be a late cutting or the start of grazing). 2022 is also the only year of the run with a net source of annual NEE at the tower (+307.6 g C m-2, FLUXNET-1F, cal-val-data).
